name: Zapatero II
description:
PM Zapatero failed to win an absolute majority in an investiture vote on 9 April 2008 (yes: 168, no: 158, abstain: 23) and was elected by simple majority in a second vote (yes: 169, no: 158, abstain: 23) two days later. The prime minister was appointed on 12 April and the cabinet was presented two days after.
Zapatero called early elections on 29 July 2011 and the cabinet ends with election on 20 November 2011.

name: Zapatero I
description:
Minority cabinet with support of small left-wing and nationalist parties, especially United Left (IU) and Left of Catalonia (ERC) (Hopkin 2005, 389).
It was appointed on 17 April  2004 (NYT).

name: Rajoy I
description:
PM Rajoy won an investiture vote on 20 December 2011 (yes: 187, no: 149, abstain: 14). He was appointed and presented his cabinet a day after.
Cabinet ended with election on 20 December 2015.

name: Trudeau J I
description:
Cabinet was appointed on 4 November 2015.
Cabinet ended with election on 21 October 2019.

name: Rajoy II
description: Caretaker cabinet continued after general election on 20 December 2015.

name: Rajoy III
description:
Caretaker cabinet continued after election on 26 June 2016.
Cabinet ended on 29 October 2016 when the new cabinet was invested.

name: Rajoy IV
description:
Cabinet won an investiture vote (yes: 170, no: 111, abstain: 68) after four months of deadlock in the formation process and was sworn in two days later.
Cabinet lost a confidence vote on 1 June 2018 (yes: 169, no: 180, constructive no-vote) and PM Sanchez was elected.

name: Sanchez I
description:
Cabinet won a constructive vote of no confidence on 1 Juni 2018 against Rajoy IV cabinet. The vote was supported by Podemos and other national parties. PM Sánchez was appointed on 2 June 2018.
Cabinet called an early election on 15 February 2019 after loosing a budget vote. It took place on 28 April.
comment: see confidence vote coded for Rajoy IV.

name: Sanchez II
description:
Continuation caretaker cabinet remained in office on 28 April 2019.
Cabinet formation failed and an election was called on 17 September 2019 that took place on 10 November.

name: Sanchez III
description: Cabinet lost an investiture vote on 5 January 2020 (yes: 166, no: 165, abstain: 18, absolute majority required) and won a vote with a simple majority two days later (yes: 167, no: 165, abstain: 18). PM Sánchez was appointed on 8 January 2020.

name: Trudeau J II
description:
Cabinet continued after election on 21 October 2019.
Cabinet ended with an early election on 20 September 2021.

name: Trudeau J III
description: Cabinet continued after election on 20 September 2021.
